prefix.note: docs/specs/book-useful.md section 8, book.news.prefix. For the easier-crowd item {r} is the softer race.

count.note: docs/specs/book-useful.md section 3.5, {k}: fronts as a word. The spec lists Four to Seven; crowded lead fires at five or more (13.1), so Four is not here. Eight front-runners leave no closer to name, so no word for eight is needed.

pairs.headline: one wants the lead
pairs.body: Only {name} wants the lead. The bugler approves.

pairs.headline: nobody to argue with
pairs.body: {name} is the lone speed. Better than its bars.

pairs.headline: a lead for one
pairs.body: No rival for the lead. {name} likes that.

pairs.headline: a class above
pairs.body: No one here is close to {name} on paper.

pairs.headline: add up the bars
pairs.body: Add up the bars. Well ahead: {name}.

pairs.headline: best by a lot
pairs.body: {name} has the most in the bars, by a lot.

pairs.headline: a cut above
pairs.body: The regular added it twice: {name}, by plenty.

pairs.headline: class of the race
pairs.body: {name} is the class here. Ask anyone.

pairs.headline: nobody near on paper
pairs.body: Even the pigeons see it: {name}, clear.

pairs.headline: {k} want the lead
pairs.body: Closers like a busy front. {name} tops them.

pairs.headline: a crowd up front
pairs.body: A busy lead helps closers. Top one here: {name}.

pairs.headline: traffic up front
pairs.body: The snack cart says closers. Top closer: {name}

pairs.headline: an easier crowd
pairs.body: {name} runs twice. Race {soft} is the easier field.

pairs.headline: softer company
pairs.body: Two starts for {name}. Race {soft} is kinder.

pairs.headline: kinder rivals
pairs.body: Race {soft} is the easier of {name}'s two.

pairs.headline: the kinder of two
pairs.body: {name}: two races. This one's softer.

pairs.headline: a gentler bunch
pairs.body: {name} runs two. Fewer bigwigs here.

pairs.headline: lighter company
pairs.body: {name} has the lighter field of two.

pairs.headline: nobody wants the lead
pairs.body: Stalkers set the pace, and {name} tops them.

pairs.headline: no speed at all
pairs.body: No early speed suits stalkers. Top one: {name}.

pairs.headline: who goes first?
pairs.body: Someone has to go first. Top stalker: {name}.

pairs.headline: drawn wide
pairs.body: Post {post} for {name}. A long way round for speed.

pairs.headline: a long way round
pairs.body: {name} drew wide, post {post}. Speed minds it a bit.

pairs.headline: parked out wide
pairs.body: {name} starts from post {post}. A long trip for speed.

pairs.headline: outside looking in
pairs.body: {name}, post {post}: a bit of extra ground.

pairs.headline: far from the rail
pairs.body: {name} is in post {post}. Costs a little.

pairs.headline: the outside seats
pairs.body: {name}: post {post}, small cost, nice view.

pairs.headline: tops on the numbers
pairs.body: On paper, {name}. Paper has been wrong before.

pairs.headline: most in the bars
pairs.body: Add the three bars. Top here: {name}.

pairs.headline: best sum here
pairs.body: Sum the bars and {name} comes out on top.
